Subject: Deep Depression over north coastal Andhra Pradesh & adjoining south Odisha 
The Deep Depression over north coastal Andhra Pradesh, moved northwestwards with a speed 
of 07 kmph during past 06 hours and lay centered at 0830 hrs IST of today, 24th September 2026 
over north coastal Andhra Pradesh & adjoining south Odisha near latitude 18.5°N and longitude 
83.5 °E, about 70 km west-northwest of Kalingapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), 80 km south-southeast 
of Rayagada (Odisha), 90 km east-southeast of Koraput (Odisha) and 170 km east-southeast of 
Jagdalpur (Chhattisgarh). 
It is very likely to move north-northwestwards and weaken gradually into a Depression around 
evening of today , the 24 th September. Thereafter it is very likely to continue to move north -
northwestwards and weaken gradually during subsequent 24 hours. 
The system is under continuous surveillance by the Doppler Weather Radar at Vishakhapatnam.    
Forecast track and intensity are given in the following table:

Warnings: 
(i) Rainfall Warning: 
Odisha: Light to moderate rainfall at most places with heavy to very heavy rainfall  with 
extremely heavy rainfall at isolated places over south Odisha and isolated heavy to very heavy 
rainfall over north Odisha on 24th September. Heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated places on 
25th over interior Odisha and heavy rainfall  at isolated places over Odisha is likely on 26th 
September. 
 
Chhattisgarh: Light to moderate rainfall at most places with heavy to very heavy rainfall  at a 
few places and extremely heavy rainfall at isolated places over south Chhattisgarh and isolated 
heavy to very heavy rainfall over north Chhattisgarh on 24th September. Heavy to very heavy 
rainfall at isolated places on 25 th and isolated heavy rainfall  on 2 6th September over 
Chhattisgarh. 
 
Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Yanam: Light to moderate rainfall at most places with heavy to 
very heavy rainfall  at isolated places over north Coastal Andhra Pradesh & Yanam on 24th 
September and Heavy rainfall at isolated places over north Coastal Andhra Pradesh is likely on 
25th September. 
 
Telangana: Light to moderate rainfall at most places with heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated 
places over northeast Telangana very likely on 24th and heavy rainfall at isolated places over east 
Telangana on 25th September. 
 
Jharkhand: Light to moderate rainfall at many places with heavy to very heavy rainfall  at 
isolated places on 24th and heavy rainfall at isolated places is very likely on 25th September. 
 
Gangetic West Bengal: Light to moderate rainfall at many places with heavy to very heavy 
rainfall at isolated places on 24th and heavy rainfall at isolated places is very likely on 2 5th 
September. 
 
East Madhya Pradesh: Light to moderate rainfall at many places with heavy rainfall at isolated 
places during 24th-27th and isolated very heavy rainfall is very likely on 25th & 26th September. 
 
Vidarbha: Light to moderate rainfall at many places with heavy to very rainfall at isolated places 
on 24th & 25th September and heavy rainfall at isolated places is very likely on 26th September. 
 . 
(ii) Wind warning: 
❖ Squally wind with speed reaching 55-65 kmph gusting to 75 kmph is prevailing over Westcentral 
and adjoining Northwest Bay of Bengal & along and off south Odisha-north Andhra Pradesh & 
Yanam coasts and likely to continue till noon and become 50-60 kmph gusting to 70 kmph in 
the evening of today, the 24th September. It is likely to become 45-55 kmph gusting to 65kmph 
from midnight of today, 24th September till morning of 25th September and decrease gradually 
thereafter. 
❖ Squally wind with speed reaching 55 -65 kmph gusting to 75 kmph is prevailing over coastal 
districts of north Andhra Pradesh  & adjoining east Telangana,  south Odisha and south 
Chhattisgarh and likely to continue till noon and becoming 50-60 kmph gusting to 70 kmph in 
the evening of today, the 24th September. It is likely to become 45-55 kmph gusting to 65kmph 
from midnight of today, 24th September till morning of 25th September and decrease gradually 
thereafter. 
❖ Squally wind speed reaching 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely over  the d istricts of 
northwest Odisha, north Ch hattisgarh and southwest Jharkhand  from 24 th evening till 25 th 
evening and decrease gradually thereafter. 
❖ Squally wind speed reaching 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely over adjoining areas of 
North and South Bay of Bengal till evening of today, the 24rd September. 
❖ Squally wind with speed reaching 4 0-50 kmph gusting to 6 0 kmph is likely along & off West 
Bengal and south Andhra Pradesh & Yanam coasts till evening of today, the 24rd September. 
 
 
 
(iii) Sea condition: 
❖ Very Rough to rough sea condition is prevailing over westcentral & northwest Bay of Bengal 
till noon and likely to become rough from evening of today, the 24th September till morning 
of 25th September and improve gradually thereafter. 
❖ Very Rough to rough sea condition is prevailing along & off north Andhra Pradesh-Odisha-
West Bengal coasts  till noon and likely to become rough from evening of today, the 24th 
September till morning of 25th September and improve gradually thereafter. 
❖ Rough sea condition is likely over adjoining areas of southwest Bay of Bengal till 24th 
September evening and gradually improve thereafter.  
 
(iv) Fishermen warnings: 
       Fishermen are advised not to venture into 
❖ Westcentral & adjoining northwest & southwest Bay of Bengal and along & off Andhra 
Pradesh-Odisha-West Bengal coasts till morning of 25th September. 
(v) Impact expected (Coastal districts of north Andhra Pradesh & Yanam and south Odisha 
for squally wind & heavy rainfall; interior districts of Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, 
Telangana, Chhattisgarh, Vidarbha , East Madhya Pradesh  and Jharkhand for heavy 
rainfall): 
❖ Breaking of tree branches, uprooting of small trees like banana, papaya, drum sticks. 
❖ Loose objects may fly. 
❖ Strong wind and rain may damage plantation, horticulture and standing crops. 
❖ Partial damage to vulnerable structures due to strong winds and rain. 
❖ Minor damage to kutcha houses/walls, huts and roads due to heavy rain. 
❖ Onshore and offshore operations may get affected. 
❖ Small ships, trawlers and boats may be affected. 
❖ Road and rail traffic may be affected due to heavy rain and squally winds. 
❖ There could be localised landslides, mudslides, landslips  in hilly areas and water logging, 
inundation and flooding over low-lying areas. 
❖ Occasional reduction in visibility due to heavy rainfall. 
❖ Helicopter services may get affected. 
Action suggested: 
❖ People are advised to keep a watch on the weather for worsening conditions and be ready to 
move to safer places accordingly.  People may stay in safe places especially during 23nd to 
24th September.  
❖ Fishing operation may be suspended till 24th September.  
❖ Surface transport may be regulated. 
❖ Tourism and recreational activities to be regulated. 
❖ Onshore and offshore activities to be judiciously regulated. 
❖ Helicopter services to be regulated. 
❖ Take safe shelters; do not take shelter under trees, as there could be lightning. 
❖ In case of expected lightning, unplug electrical/ electronic appliances, immediately, get out of 
water bodies and keep away from all the objects that conduct electricity. 
 
Chief Amount of Rainfall (≥7cm) and Wind Speed occurred during 0830 hrs IST of Yesterday to 0830 
hrs IST of today, the 24th September, 2026 is given in Annexure -1. 
           
 
Next bulletin will be issued at 1430 hours IST of today, the 24th September, 2026.
